info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Mutual Fund Administration API
info.description: The Mutual Fund Administration API facilitates access to essential mutual fund management operations within banking systems. This API allows users to retrieve detailed information about mutual fund transactions, account statuses, and fund performance metrics. Typical consumers include financial institutions, investment managers, and financial advisors who require real-time data for informed decision-making. By integrating this API, organizations can enhance their operational efficiency, optimize client services, and support various financial products related to mutual fund offerings.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access details regarding the administration of mutual funds, including relevant operational information and statuses.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding mutual fund administration operations. Ensure all required parameters are included to get accurate results.

200.description: Successfully retrieved mutual fund administration data.
